notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hey everyone! In this patch, a few minor problems were taken care of to help improve the game. Here's what was fixed/changed:



-The platforms on the Lost Land don't push you off randomly anymore.

-Some problems related to lighting have been fixed.

-Overall performance boost (added ambient occlusion to all levels).

-Removed the Minimap due to some issues with the ambient occlusion.

-Added a more clear indicator towards the Decryption Engineer on AT-559.

-Fixed some NavMesh problems with the AI.

-Dialogue corrections

-And a couple of other minor bug fixes (UI, Graphical. etc.)



Thanks!
